title: KnowledgeAdoptRequest
description: Adopt a shared KnowledgeEntry into a destination scope (spoke-knowledge-adoption). Requires the negotiated spoke-knowledge-adoption and mandatory co-capability spoke-knowledge; without them the connect gate answers op_unsupported / capability_missing. A merged source resolves through its retirement chain to the terminal live source (at most 32 edges); cycle, ambiguous, deleted-terminal, or over-limit resolution answers SOURCE_RETIRED with details.retirement_chain. A missing, out-of-scope, or non-disclosable owner-private source answers generic NOT_FOUND. Mutating op: idempotency_key is required; dedup namespace (effective_scope, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key); same-key different-digest answers IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

source_scope_id.description: Requested source scope. Retirement resolution can change the terminal scope/id recorded by the anchor.

destination_scope_id.description: Destination scope admitted by the host.

destination_entry_id.description: Optional destination id. When absent, the resolved terminal source_entry_id is the default; for a live source this equals the requested id.

idempotency_key.description: Connect retry key, 1-128 Unicode code points inclusive; unique within the dedup namespace (effective_scope, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key). Length is not counted in UTF-16 code units or UTF-8 bytes.
idempotency_key.title: IdempotencyKey
